NotchPrompter collects no data. Speech i: NotchPrompter collects no data. Speech is recognised on your Mac, and scripts and recordings stay on your Mac.
NotchPrompter is made to keep your words: NotchPrompter is made to keep your words to yourself. In short: we collect nothing.
Scripts are saved only on your Mac, in t: Scripts are saved only on your Mac, in the app's own folder. They are never sent to us or anyone else. When you import or export a file, the app only reads or writes the file you choose.
When you turn on voice-follow, NotchProm: When you turn on voice-follow, NotchPrompter listens to the microphone and turns your speech into words, to find your place in the script. Voice-follow never saves audio, and the words are only used while you read.
Speech recognition is done by Apple's Sp: Speech recognition is done by Apple's Speech framework, on your Mac. By default NotchPrompter never sends your speech anywhere. macOS only recognises speech on the Mac when Dictation is turned on in System Settings → Keyboard. If Dictation is off, or your Mac can't recognise a language on its own, you can choose to allow Apple's servers instead. Then your speech is sent to Apple to be turned into text, under Apple's privacy policy. We never receive it.
NotchPrompter uses the camera only when: NotchPrompter uses the camera only when you press record. It films you with the camera and microphone and saves the movie in the NotchPrompter folder in your Movies folder. Recordings are never uploaded, and we never receive them. You can delete them in Finder like any other file.
You can turn off camera, microphone and: You can turn off camera, microphone and speech access at any time in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
The iPhone app follows the same rules. S: The iPhone app follows the same rules. Scripts are saved only on your iPhone. Speech is recognised on your iPhone by default. For languages it can't recognise by itself, you can allow Apple's servers in the app's settings, as on the Mac.
The iPhone app shows the front camera wh: The iPhone app shows the front camera while the prompter is open, so you can see yourself, and films you when you press record. Takes are saved to your Photos library. The app only asks to add to Photos, so it can't see your other photos.
The one-time unlock is bought through th: The one-time unlock is bought through the App Store. Apple handles the payment, and we never see your name or payment details. The app only checks with the App Store whether the unlock was bought.
There are none. The app has no account,: There are none. The app has no account, no analytics, no ads and no tracking, and it does not connect to any server of ours.
The app collects no data from anyone, in: The app collects no data from anyone, including children.
If this policy changes, the new version: If this policy changes, the new version will be posted on this page with a new date.
